title: cmd_votes printer crashes on legacy vote records (TypeError in _print_tally)
desc: Found by barry while running votes for Carlo's review push (review #ef03de97): chatcode votes crashes with TypeError in _print_tally at bin/chatcode:1929 - v['vote'] is None for legacy vote messages from the old decision mechanic (e.g. #b82af0ab/#87d4bbcc, which carry a verdict in free text, not the vote/inspected fields), and collect_votes also counts such records as phantom trusted ballots. Impact: chatcode votes is unusable, blocking Carlo's all-reviews push. Fix: skip records whose vote field is not accept/deny in the tally, print them as legacy notes instead; red on main (crash), green on branch (tallies print, phantom ballot gone). --mine
